home.title: Build your fleet.

rules.title: Rules of starfall
rules.description: Everything you need to command a fleet: setup, turn structure, card abilities, combat, and the edge cases that matter when a battle comes down to a single point of Authority.
rules.intro: Starfall is a two-player deckbuilding combat game. Each player begins a standard match with {emphasis}. Generate Combat with your fleet and spend it to reduce the opposing commander’s Authority to zero. The first player to do so wins immediately.
rules.prepare: {emphasis} Each player starts with ten Ships: eight Scouts that produce Trade and two Troopers that produce Combat. Shuffle your deck and place it face down.
rules.setAuthority: {emphasis} Both players begin at 50 Authority in a standard game. Or host player may choose another starting value.
rules.outpostPriority: While an opponent controls an {emphasis}, destroy all of their Outposts before attacking that player or any non-Outpost Base they control.
rules.customAuthority: A game host may choose a different starting value for a custom match.
rules.autoStart: The battle starts automatically when the second player joins. The first player is chosen at random and draws three cards; the second player draws five.
rules.tradeDescription: Spend Trade to acquire Ships and Bases. Unspent Trade disappears at the end of your turn.
rules.combatDescription: Spend Combat to destroy enemy Bases or attack the opposing player. It does not carry over.
rules.authorityDescription: Your survival total. Healing may raise it above its starting value; there is no normal maximum.
rules.shipsDescription: Ships enter play, provide resources or abilities, and remain in your play area for the current turn. At the end of the turn they go to your discard pile.
rules.basesDescription: Bases stay in play between turns and may provide their abilities again on each of your turns. Their Defense shows how much Combat is needed to destroy them.
rules.baseStays: A Base enters your play area and remains there until destroyed, scrapped, or removed by an effect.
rules.baseCost: To destroy a Base, spend Combat equal to its current Defense.
rules.baseDiscard: A destroyed Base goes to its owner’s discard pile; it is not permanently removed from the deck.
rules.baseExcess: Combat beyond the required Defense is not assigned automatically. Unspent Combat remains available for another legal target.
rules.factionDescription: Faction is the backbone of deck synergy. Specializing makes Ally abilities more reliable; mixing factions gives you broader tactical options.
rules.blobDescription: Aggressive Combat, rapid card draw, and effects that scrap undesirable cards from the Trade Row.
rules.tradeFactionDescription: Strong Trade generation and Authority recovery, supported by durable economic Bases.
rules.empireDescription: Combat pressure, card draw, and disruption that forces the opponent to discard.
rules.machineDescription: Deck refinement through scrapping, efficient Combat, and resilient Bases.
rules.acquireDiscard: Newly acquired cards normally go to your discard pile, not your hand.
rules.shuffle: Never shuffle early. When you must draw and your deck is empty, shuffle the discard pile to form a new deck, then continue drawing.
rules.publicDiscard: Cards in your discard pile are public information; the order of your face-down deck is not.
rules.scrapHeap: Cards sent to the Scrap Heap are removed for the rest of the match unless an effect explicitly retrieves them.
rules.scrapStrategy: Scrapping weak starting cards strengthens future hands, but removing too much Trade can limit later purchases.
rules.victoryText: Victory is immediate. You do not need to finish resolving unused Trade, Combat, or optional effects after the opposing player reaches zero Authority.

turn.intro: You may perform the actions below in any useful order unless a card or pending choice says otherwise. You can play a card, buy a card, resolve an ability, then continue playing. The interface tracks available Trade and Combat for you.
turn.playText: Play any or all Ships from your hand face up. Bases already under your control remain in play. Drawn cards may also be played this turn.
turn.abilitiesText: Gain resources from primary abilities, trigger Ally abilities when their condition is met, and make any required choices. Optional abilities may be skipped.
turn.acquireText: Spend Trade equal to a card’s cost. Acquired cards normally enter your discard pile and cannot be played immediately. Replace a purchased Trade Row card at once. Explorers remain available while their supply lasts.
turn.attackText: Spend Combat against enemy Bases or the opposing player. Outposts must be destroyed before you can attack other targets that they protect.
turn.endText: Discard every Ship you played and every card left in your hand. Set unused Trade and Combat to zero, then draw a new hand of five cards. Bases remain in play.

abilities.primaryText: The main effect of a Ship when played or of a Base on your turn. Resolve every listed effect unless it is explicitly optional.
abilities.allyText: Activates when another card of the same faction is in play on your side. Play order does not matter: if a second matching card arrives later, eligible Ally abilities become available. Each ability is used at most once per turn.
abilities.scrapText: Remove that card from play to gain its Scrap effect. You may use its primary and Ally abilities first, then Scrap it. The card does not enter your discard pile at the end of the turn.
abilities.choicesText: Some abilities ask you to choose a card, a Base, or one of several effects. Resolve the pending choice before continuing. If an effect is marked optional, you may cancel it.
abilities.warning: {emphasis} scrapping a card from your hand or discard pile does not activate that card’s printed Scrap ability. A Scrap ability only triggers when you use it from a card you control in play.
